summary: Architecture review completed. The Strategy Lab correctly stays SHADOW-only, avoids single-wallet copying, and focuses on net P&L after costs, but the current repository still lacks fresh runtime evidence and has two material research gaps: the Solana shadow lane intentionally has no contemporaneous executable quote edge, and forecast strategies do not yet persist calibration/out-of-sample label metrics needed to judge durable positive net edge after costs.

evidence.detail: load_solana_market_features intentionally sets gross_edge_bps/liquidity_score/sellability_score/forecast_expected_net_bps to zero, marks needs_quote_feature_adapter=true, and returns outcome_basis=SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE.
test_solana_adapter_does_not_invent_current_edge asserts gross_edge_bps == 0, liquidity_score == 0, sellability_score == 0, outcome_available is False, and no Solana signal becomes eligible.
scorecard can only summarize quote/simulation evidence that already exists; without a Solana executable quote adapter, the hourly lane cannot produce comparable Solana cost-adjusted shadow evidence.

proposals.rationale: The current Solana path is correctly fail-closed, but that also means the repository cannot independently judge whether any Solana strategy family has executable positive net edge after fees, slippage, priority cost, latency and sellability. This blocks cross-chain strategy comparison and keeps Solana strategy conclusions architecture-only.
proposals.expected_effect: A bounded SHADOW-only Solana quote/simulation adapter would let the lab measure current executable net edge, quote freshness and liquidity/sellability on Solana without weakening live protections, improving cross-chain evidence quality.
proposals.downside_risk: If the adapter relies on stale quotes or historical wallet outcomes as a substitute for executable edge, it could create false confidence and overstate portability from EVM research to Solana.
proposals.shadow_test: Keep SHADOW_ONLY. Populate Solana features only from contemporaneous quote/simulation data with explicit quote age, fees, priority/Jito cost, slippage and sellability measurements. Over at least 3 independent windows, require non-zero eligible Solana observations plus chain-specific scorecards; stop and reject if the added adapter merely increases activity without positive quote-simulated net after costs or if freshness/liquidity gates degrade.

evidence.detail: FORECAST_RESEARCH_SPEC requires strict time ordering, probability calibration (Brier/log loss), net P&L after recorded costs, and separate regime/chain-specific validation.

forecasted_positive_net_edge emits forecast_positive_edge_probability, forecast_expected_net_bps and forecast_uncertainty, so the architecture already exposes forecast outputs that should later be calibrated.

shadow_strategy_events and scorecard persist counts and quote_simulated_net_base but do not store realized labels, calibration metrics, or chain-by-regime forecast breakdowns required by the research spec.

proposals.rationale: Without later label linkage and calibration reporting, the lab can tell that a forecast fired, but not whether forecast probabilities were trustworthy or whether thresholding improved durable net P&L after costs rather than simply selecting optimistic quotes.
proposals.expected_effect: Persisting pre-trade forecast outputs and later realized labels would allow chain-specific calibration, uncertainty abstention tuning, and out-of-sample checks that align forecast selection with money-weighted net profitability.
proposals.downside_risk: Adding forecast analytics without strict time ordering or chain/regime splits could overfit one chain or one market regime and give a misleading sense of robustness.
proposals.shadow_test: Keep SHADOW_ONLY. For each eligible forecast signal, persist the pre-trade probability/expected-edge/uncertainty and later attach a realized positive-net-edge-after-costs label when available. Accept only if out-of-sample Brier/log loss and net P&L after costs improve on separate Solana and EVM scorecards over at least 3 windows / 30 trades; reject if calibration improves only in-sample or one chain degrades materially.

evidence.detail: The laboratory explicitly prioritizes learned patterns from multiple profitable public routes/behaviour and warns against dependence on a single leader wallet.

profitable_wallet_research hashes wallet identities, requires PROVEN_WRAPPED_BASE evidence, aggregates net/gross profit and route counts, and instructs reviewers to use wallets as research evidence rather than copy targets.
ensure_cross_chain_scope seeds 'Profitable Wallet Pattern Transfer' with require_multiple_wallets=true, require_proven_net=true, and copy_single_wallet=false.

proposals.rationale: This is the repository's strongest differentiated research lane because it turns profitable-wallet behaviour into falsifiable, multi-wallet pattern hypotheses instead of direct leader imitation, which better diversifies edge sources and matches the durable net-P&L objective.
proposals.expected_effect: Keeping this governance intact preserves a safer path for discovering repeatable behaviours across both chain families while avoiding unsupported live inference from one wallet or one chain.
proposals.downside_risk: Wallet-cohort profitability can still be regime-specific, crowded or non-portable, so the strategy must remain SHADOW-only until chain-specific after-cost evidence is refreshed.
proposals.shadow_test: Keep SHADOW_ONLY. Continue admitting only patterns observed across more than one profitable wallet and require positive net after costs, acceptable participation and no concentration collapse across at least 3 windows per chain; reject any candidate whose edge disappears after fees/slippage or whose evidence comes from only one wallet cohort.

rejected_ideas.idea: Claim any strategy is profitable, canary-ready or live-ready from this cycle alone.
rejected_ideas.reason: The issue states fresh runtime evidence within 2h is false, and the workflow explicitly forbids profitability/canary/live claims when runtime evidence is stale or missing.

rejected_ideas.idea: Turn profitable public wallets into direct copy targets or lower executability gates to force activity.
rejected_ideas.reason: The Strategy Lab documentation and research helpers explicitly prefer repeated multi-wallet patterns, and the common executable gates require positive net edge, liquidity, sellability and quote freshness before eligibility.

evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime evidence within 2h is false, so this review is architecture-only and cannot support profitability, canary-readiness or live-readiness claims.
The current Solana market-feature adapter intentionally lacks contemporaneous executable quote/liquidity/sellability measurements, leaving Solana strategy evidence fail-closed.
Forecast signals are generated, but the shadow scorecard does not yet persist realized labels or calibration metrics such as Brier/log loss for chain-specific out-of-sample evaluation.
No fresh chain-by-chain realized after-cost scorecard was available in this task context to confirm whether any strategy family remains positive after execution leakage.
